Percent style encodes spaces and parens in link URLs

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<a href="/file (1).pdf">file</a>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(url_escape_style: 'Percent'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
